analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: US Quant Pauses; Japan ELS “On” & Quant Resumes; Hyperscalers Bgt
key_insights: The UBS US Quant deleveraging indicator paused after being active for all five sessions last week. Quants still cut a further -0.7std of gross yesterday, performance remains weak at -48bps, and the model expects more deleveraging today.
The US Equity L/S deleveraging indicator paused on Friday last week.
In Japan, the Equity L/S indicator remains on and the Quant indicator has resumed because of weak performance.
Equity L/S hedge funds supported yesterday's US rally with net buying of +1std of US equities, split about 50/50 between long buying and short covering.

US flow was led by long buying in Hyperscalers (+2.3std) and US Software (+2.1std), and by covering and long buying in US Transportation (+2.4std). By factor, flow skewed to High Quality names (+2.3std).
Equity L/S performance is estimated at -64bps yesterday in the US. Funds were caught offside by the rally after de-risking heavily beforehand and adding hedging shorts in Industrials and Tech.

European flows were de-grossing, with -1.0std of European equities de-risked. Hedge funds sold long exposure by -1.1std, concentrated in profit taking in Tech & Hardware, which lifted performance by +80bps on the day.
European hedge funds covered short exposure by +0.5std, concentrated in Food, Bevs & Tobacco as the sector squeezed higher.
risk_factors: Further quant deleveraging in the US is expected today by UBS's model, with quant performance still weak.
US Equity L/S funds were caught offside by the rally after heavy de-risking and hedging, which exposes them to further underperformance if the rally continues.
Japan deleveraging signals remain active for both Equity L/S and Quant strategies.
vol_and_positioning: US Quant deleveraging indicator paused after five active sessions last week. Quants cut a further -0.7std of gross yesterday, with performance at -48bps, and UBS's model expects further deleveraging today.
US Equity L/S deleveraging indicator paused on Friday. Equity L/S net bought +1std of US equities yesterday, split about 50/50 long buying and covering, and performance is estimated at -64bps.
Japan Equity L/S deleveraging indicator remains on and the Japan Quant indicator has resumed.
Europe saw -1.0std of net de-risking. Long selling was -1.1std in Tech & Hardware and short covering was +0.5std in Food, Bevs & Tobacco.
US flow by group: Hyperscalers +2.3std, US Software +2.1std, US Transportation +2.4std (covering and long buying). By factor, High Quality names +2.3std.
US Equity L/S funds had heavily de-risked and added hedging shorts in Industrials and Tech before the rally.
